verse_text_english: In the name of God, Most Gracious,
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: The Hour has come closer, and the moon has split.*
verse_text_arabic: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verse_text_transliterated: iq'tarabati l-sāʿatu wa-inshaqqa l-qamar
verse_footnote_english: *54:1 This important sign of the approaching end of the world came to pass in 1969 when humans landed on the moon and brought pieces of the moon to earth. At the same time, God’s mathematical Miracle of the Quran was being gradually unveiled. Traditional Muslims opposed it, since it exposed the fallacy of their practices (App. 25). 2 2417 The Moon (Al-Qamar) 54:7-27 529
verse_text_arabic_clean: اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر

verse_text_english: Then they saw a miracle; but they turned away and said, “Old magic.”
verse_text_arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-in yaraw āyatan yuʿ'riḍū wayaqūlū siḥ'run mus'tamirru
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن يروا ءاية يعرضوا ويقولوا سحر مستمر

verse_text_english: They disbelieved, followed their opinions, and adhered to their old traditions.
verse_text_arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verse_text_transliterated: wakadhabū wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum wakullu amrin mus'taqirru
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكذبوا واتبعوا أهواءهم وكل أمر مستقر

verse_text_english: Sufficient warnings have been delivered to alert them.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad jāahum mina l-anbāi mā fīhi muz'dajaru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد جاءهم من الأنباء ما فيه مزدجر

verse_text_english: Great wisdom; but all the warnings have been in vain.
verse_text_arabic: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verse_text_transliterated: ḥik'matun bālighatun famā tugh'ni l-nudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: حكمة بلغة فما تغن النذر

verse_text_english: Ignore them; the day will come when the caller will announce a terrible disaster.
verse_text_arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fatawalla ʿanhum yawma yadʿu l-dāʿi ilā shayin nukuri
verse_text_arabic_clean: فتول عنهم يوم يدع الداع إلى شىء نكر

verse_text_english: With their eyes humiliated, they come out of the graves like scattered locusts.
verse_text_arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: khushaʿan abṣāruhum yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi ka-annahum jarādun muntashiru
verse_text_arabic_clean: خشعا أبصرهم يخرجون من الأجداث كأنهم جراد منتشر

verse_text_english: As they respond to the caller, the disbelievers will say, “This is a difficult day.”
verse_text_arabic: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: muh'ṭiʿīna ilā l-dāʿi yaqūlu l-kāfirūna hādhā yawmun ʿasiru
verse_text_arabic_clean: مهطعين إلى الداع يقول الكفرون هذا يوم عسر

verse_text_english: The people of Noah disbelieved before them. They disbelieved our servant and said, “Crazy!” He was persecuted.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin fakadhabū ʿabdanā waqālū majnūnun wa-uz'dujir
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح فكذبوا عبدنا وقالوا مجنون وازدجر

verse_text_english: He implored his Lord, “I am oppressed; grant me victory.”
verse_text_arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
verse_text_transliterated: fadaʿā rabbahu annī maghlūbun fa-intaṣi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فدعا ربه أنى مغلوب فانتصر

verse_text_english: We then opened the gates of the sky, pouring water.
verse_text_arabic: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fafataḥnā abwāba l-samāi bimāin mun'hamiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ففتحنا أبوب السماء بماء منهمر

verse_text_english: And we caused springs to gush out of the earth. a predetermined decision.
verse_text_arabic: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
verse_text_transliterated: wafajjarnā l-arḍa ʿuyūnan fal-taqā l-māu ʿalā amrin qad qudir
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفجرنا الأرض عيونا فالتقى الماء على أمر قد قدر

verse_text_english: We carried him on a watercraft made of logs and ropes.
verse_text_arabic: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: waḥamalnāhu ʿalā dhāti alwāḥin wadusuri
verse_text_arabic_clean: وحملنه على ذات ألوح ودسر

verse_text_english: It ran under our watchful eyes; a reward for one who was rejected.
verse_text_arabic: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verse_text_transliterated: tajrī bi-aʿyuninā jazāan liman kāna kufir
verse_text_arabic_clean: تجرى بأعيننا جزاء لمن كان كفر

verse_text_english: We have set it up as a lesson. Does any of you wish to learn?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad taraknāhā āyatan fahal min muddakiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد تركنها ءاية فهل من مدكر

verse_text_english: How terrible was My retribution after the warnings!
verse_text_arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكيف كان عذابى ونذر

verse_text_english: We made the Quran easy to learn. Does any of you wish to learn?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر

verse_text_english: Aad disbelieved. Consequently, how terrible was My retribution after the warnings.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabat ʿādun fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبت عاد فكيف كان عذابى ونذر

verse_text_english: We sent upon them violent winds, on a day of continuous misery.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
verse_text_transliterated: innā arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī yawmi naḥsin mus'tamirri
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أرسلنا عليهم ريحا صرصرا فى يوم نحس مستمر

verse_text_english: It tossed the people around as if they were decayed palm tree trunks.
verse_text_arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: tanziʿu l-nāsa ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin munqaʿiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: تنزع الناس كأنهم أعجاز نخل منقعر

verse_text_english: How terrible was My retribution after the warnings!
verse_text_arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكيف كان عذابى ونذر

verse_text_english: We made the Quran easy to learn. Does any of you wish to learn?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر

verse_text_english: Thamoud rejected the warnings.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabat thamūdu bil-nudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبت ثمود بالنذر

verse_text_english: They said, “Shall we follow one of us; a human being? We will then go astray, then end up in Hell.
verse_text_arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: faqālū abasharan minnā wāḥidan nattabiʿuhu innā idhan lafī ḍalālin wasuʿuri
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقالوا أبشرا منا وحدا نتبعه إنا إذا لفى ضلل وسعر

verse_text_english: “Did the message come down to him, instead of us? He is a flagrant liar.”
verse_text_arabic: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: a-ul'qiya l-dhik'ru ʿalayhi min bayninā bal huwa kadhābun ashiru
verse_text_arabic_clean: أءلقى الذكر عليه من بيننا بل هو كذاب أشر

verse_text_english: They will find out tomorrow who the flagrant liar is.
verse_text_arabic: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
verse_text_transliterated: sayaʿlamūna ghadan mani l-kadhābu l-ashir
verse_text_arabic_clean: سيعلمون غدا من الكذاب الأشر

verse_text_english: We are sending the camel as a test for them. Watch them and be patient. 0 2417 530
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
verse_text_transliterated: innā mur'silū l-nāqati fit'natan lahum fa-ir'taqib'hum wa-iṣ'ṭabi
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا مرسلوا الناقة فتنة لهم فارتقبهم واصطبر

verse_text_english: Inform them that the water shall be divided among them; (the camel) shall be allowed to drink on her designated day.
verse_text_arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wanabbi'hum anna l-māa qis'matun baynahum kullu shir'bin muḥ'taḍaru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ونبئهم أن الماء قسمة بينهم كل شرب محتضر

verse_text_english: But they persuaded their friend to kill (the camel), and he obliged.
verse_text_arabic: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: fanādaw ṣāḥibahum fataʿāṭā faʿaqar
verse_text_arabic_clean: فنادوا صاحبهم فتعاطى فعقر

verse_text_english: Consequently, how terrible was My retribution! They have been warned.
verse_text_arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: فكيف كان عذابى ونذر

verse_text_english: We sent upon them one blow, whereupon they became like harvested hay.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse_text_transliterated: innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fakānū kahashīmi l-muḥ'taẓir
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أرسلنا عليهم صيحة وحدة فكانوا كهشيم المحتظر

verse_text_english: We made the Quran easy to learn. Does any of you wish to learn?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر

verse_text_english: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabat qawmu lūṭin bil-nudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبت قوم لوط بالنذر

verse_text_english: We showered them with rocks. Only Lot’s family was saved at dawn.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭin najjaynāhum bisaḥari
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أرسلنا عليهم حاصبا إلا ءال لوط نجينهم بسحر

verse_text_english: We blessed him and his family; we thus reward the appreciative.
verse_text_arabic: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: niʿ'matan min ʿindinā kadhālika najzī man shakar
verse_text_arabic_clean: نعمة من عندنا كذلك نجزى من شكر

verse_text_english: He warned them about our requital, but they ridiculed the warnings.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad andharahum baṭshatanā fatamāraw bil-nudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد أنذرهم بطشتنا فتماروا بالنذر

verse_text_english: They negotiated with him about his guests; we blinded them. retribution; you have been warned.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi faṭamasnā aʿyunahum fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد رودوه عن ضيفه فطمسنا أعينهم فذوقوا عذابى ونذر

verse_text_english: Early the next morning, a devastating retribution struck them.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ṣabbaḥahum buk'ratan ʿadhābun mus'taqirru
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد صبحهم بكرة عذاب مستقر

verse_text_english: Suffer My retribution; you have been warned.
verse_text_arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: فذوقوا عذابى ونذر

verse_text_english: We made the Quran easy to learn. Does any of you wish to learn?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد يسرنا القرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر

verse_text_english: Pharaoh’s people were warned.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad jāa āla fir'ʿawna l-nudhur
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد جاء ءال فرعون النذر

verse_text_english: They rejected all our signs. Conse­ quently, we requited them as an Almighty, Omnipotent should.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabū biāyātinā kullihā fa-akhadhnāhum akhdha ʿazīzin muq'tadiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبوا بـٔايتنا كلها فأخذنهم أخذ عزيز مقتدر

verse_text_english: Are your disbelievers better than those disbelievers? absolved by the scripture?
verse_text_arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: akuffārukum khayrun min ulāikum am lakum barāatun fī l-zubur
verse_text_arabic_clean: أكفاركم خير من أولئكم أم لكم براءة فى الزبر

verse_text_english: Perhaps they think, “We will be the winners.”
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: am yaqūlūna naḥnu jamīʿun muntaṣiru
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم يقولون نحن جميع منتصر

verse_text_english: All of them will be defeated; they will turn around and flee.
verse_text_arabic: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verse_text_transliterated: sayuh'zamu l-jamʿu wayuwallūna l-dubur
verse_text_arabic_clean: سيهزم الجمع ويولون الدبر

verse_text_english: The Hour is awaiting them, and the Hour is far worse and more painful.
verse_text_arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verse_text_transliterated: bali l-sāʿatu mawʿiduhum wal-sāʿatu adhā wa-amarr
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل الساعة موعدهم والساعة أدهى وأمر

verse_text_english: Certainly, the guilty are astray, and will end up in Hell.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-muj'rimīna fī ḍalālin wasuʿuri
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن المجرمين فى ضلل وسعر

verse_text_english: They will be dragged into the hellfire, forcibly. Suffer the agony of retribution.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma yus'ḥabūna fī l-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim dhūqū massa saqar
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم يسحبون فى النار على وجوههم ذوقوا مس سقر

verse_text_english: Everything we created is precisely measured. 0 2417
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: innā kulla shayin khalaqnāhu biqadari
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا كل شىء خلقنه بقدر

verse_text_english: Our commands are done within the blink of an eye. 531
verse_text_arabic: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥin bil-baṣar
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما أمرنا إلا وحدة كلمح بالبصر

verse_text_english: We annihilated your counterparts. Does any of you wish to learn?
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad ahlaknā ashyāʿakum fahal min muddakiri
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد أهلكنا أشياعكم فهل من مدكر

verse_text_english: Everything they did is recorded in the scriptures.
verse_text_arabic: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wakullu shayin faʿalūhu fī l-zubur
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكل شىء فعلوه فى الزبر

verse_text_english: Everything, small or large, is written down.
verse_text_arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wakullu ṣaghīrin wakabīrin mus'taṭaru
verse_text_arabic_clean: وكل صغير وكبير مستطر

verse_text_english: Surely, the righteous have deserved gardens and rivers.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanahari
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن المتقين فى جنت ونهر

verse_text_english: In a position of honor, at an Omnipotent King. (
verse_text_arabic: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: fī maqʿadi ṣid'qin ʿinda malīkin muq'tadiri
